title: The reader's chair, taken
logline: The reading room with someone in it: a stranger from behind at the table under the green lamp with the (finch) folder open, reading. Which page they're on: a back page, 1998, the reader can tell by the shape. He doesn't go in.

panels.composition: A library reading room from its doorway: a stranger from behind at a table under a green lamp with a folder open before them, a photocopied comic page visible in it, metal shelves behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a library reading room seen from its doorway with a stranger seen from behind at a table under a green-shaded lamp reading from an open folder holding a photocopied comic page, metal shelves behind, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
